The contact 'fwod4-n2 Bench Customer' had already been created by the earlier replayed segments; the stored segment's failure was only its verification step, which had opened the wrong record (id=44 = 'fwod4-n1 Bench Customer'). I returned to the Customers kanban (4 records), confirmed the n2 card showed "Benchville", opened it (record id=45), and verified on the reopened form: Name = "fwod4-n2 Bench Customer", City = "Benchville", and the company_type radio is "Individual" (checked) with "Company" unchecked — an individual contact, not a company. Screenshot saved to fwod4-n2_customer_verified.png.

Continued from the interrupted replay on the new quotation form: the customer 'fwod4-n2 Bench Customer' had already been selected via the autocomplete dropdown (input value confirmed) and one order line existed with qty 1.00. I clicked the Quantity cell, set it to 3, and saved. Verified on the saved record (id=22): product "Customizable Desk" (qty 3.00, unit price £750.00, line total £2,250.00), Untaxed Amount £2,250.00, TAX 20% £450.00, Total £2,700.00, reference S00022, status "Quotation" (draft, not confirmed). Verified after saving: line 1 unchanged (Customizable Desk (Steel, White) qty 3.00 @ £750.00 = £2,250.00), line 2 = "Office Chair Black" [FURN_0269] qty 2.00 @ £120.50 = £241.00, new Untaxed Amount £2,491.00 (TAX 20% £498.20, Total £2,989.20). Status remains "Quotation" (draft, not confirmed). Screenshot: fwod4-n2_quotation_S00022_second_line.png.

Ran the matching stored procedure s_5a87a3 (6/6 steps ok) on the draft quotation S00022 (id=22, customer fwod4-n2 Bench Customer): it changed only line 1's quantity from 3 to 5.00. Verified after saving: line 1 'Customizable Desk (Steel, White)' qty 5.00 @ £750.00 = £3,750.00, line 2 'Office Chair Black' qty 2.00 @ £120.50 = £241.00 unchanged, new Untaxed Amount £3,991.00 (TAX 20% £798.20, Total £4,789.20). Status remains "Quotation" (draft, Confirm button still available, not confirmed). Screenshot: fwod4-n2_quotation_S00022_qty5.png.

Ran the matching stored procedure s_4eef29 (2/2 steps ok) on the draft quotation S00022 (id=22, customer fwod4-n2 Bench Customer): armed dialog acceptance and clicked Confirm. The Confirm button disappeared and "Create Invoice" appeared, and the status bar now shows "Sales Order" as the active state (Quotation Sent / Quotation inactive). Order reference read from the form title and document title: S00022. Screenshot: fwod4-n2_order_S00022_confirmed.png.
